baseline.rule: Establish BASELINE first. No invented targets.
baseline.what_is_baseline: Every stage is a MEASURED sample set (or ABSENT with a physical reason). Medians are the baseline. There is no budget, SLO, or 'should be < N ms' in this receipt.

breakdown.blocking_dep: weight residency (optional) then graph-cold first CB

largest_contributor.label: warm short-prompt prefill on the production decode GEMV graph

per_token_largest.note: TPOT/inter-token IS the complete-token wall; operator is the intra-CB majority.

largest_contributor.why: INTERACTIVE (S022 §5) is the user-visible first-token wait with the q4 incumbent already resident. Prefill of the chat wrap is the wall. Control-plane overlay (admission+schedule+compile) is tens of milliseconds. Sampler is already fused into the decode CB (~0.3 ms GPU). Per-token, GPU operator dominates (~80% of GPU_NS) — GPU_LEDGER stages.operator live_ns=23431928.95918069.

method.anti_goodhart: Rank by measured milliseconds of the INTERACTIVE first-token wait, not by how ugly a 20 µs which() looks. Ultimate correlate is verified-work/wall (§42), not tok/s.
method.control_plane: Reuse receipts/headless/CONTROL_PLANE_LATENCY_LEDGER.json (N022). Do not re-time grok_bridge / Swift / scheduler.
method.gpu_this_lane: Not re-run. Remeasurement would load the q4 27B. Existing complete-wall receipts ARE the decode-path measurement. If a later lane remasures: bash tools/gpu_lane_lock.sh n028-latency …
method.model_side: TTFT from PRODUCTION_BENCH q4 c=1 ttft_s. Prefill from PREFILL_KV q4 short warm_prefill_wall_ns. TPOT / inter-token / p50/p95/p99 from GPU_LEDGER_RAW pooled_steady_complete_wall_ns (actual hybrid_greedy complete-wall decode path). Sampler from TOKEN_NS isolated argmax GPU reps + live CPU argmax_f32.
method.wall: time.perf_counter for live CPU; GPUEnd−GPUStart for GPU (GPU_LEDGER authority)

profile.definition: User-visible short-context c=1 path: resident q4 incumbent, chat wrap, first-token wait then streaming tokens. Not batch, not c=4, not 16K prefill. Control-plane overlay is the N022 warm figures. Model-side is the production decode path.
profile.name: INTERACTIVE

question: What is the user-visible INTERACTIVE latency vector, as a per-stage breakdown with a named largest contributor?

admission.classification_reason: Cold path compiles a temp Swift Metal probe (~276 ms). Warm/cached is ~23 ms. Cacheable: metal_device + genome JSON. Not fusible into the decode CB.
admission.note: Reused N022 runtime_admission (not re-timed). cold_median_ms=276.418 warm_median_ms=22.556. INTERACTIVE overlay uses the warm figure (process already up).

cold_start.blocking_dep: weight residency (optional) then graph-cold first CB
cold_start.classification_reason: Decode-path cold is the first step of the first generate in a fresh process (graph-cold, role=prefill). Cacheable: keep the process/pipelines resident. Avoidable as a per-turn cost. Weight load is a separate process-level figure (n=1).

extra.os_page_cache_cold_reason: A true disk-cold run requires dropping the kernel page cache. This session cannot sudo purge. Three sequential processes share the ~14 GiB artifact page cache.

cold_start.note: Headline is graph-cold first complete_wall (n=3 processes). OS page-cache-cold is ABSENT (sudo purge not run). Weight load (PRODUCTION_BENCH.q4.raw load_ns) is 5397.367 ms n=1 — reported as extra, not mixed into the graph-cold median.

context_compile.classification_reason: GoalCompiler.compile of the INTERACTIVE goal text is <1 ms. Cacheable for an unchanged goal. Not the first-token cost.
context_compile.note: Reused N022 context_compile (not re-timed). cold_median_ms=0.416 warm_median_ms=0.125. INTERACTIVE overlay uses the warm figure (process already up).

inter_token.classification_reason: Inter-token latency is the same complete-token wall as TPOT on this greedy path: tokens are emitted one CB at a time. A trivial sleep() would not reproduce the 30 ms GPU interval.
inter_token.note: Identical sample set to tpot. Named separately because the acceptance vector lists both.

prefill.classification_reason: Teacher-forced walk of every prompt token on the production decode GEMV graph (964 dispatches / step). Not avoidable for a new prompt. Cacheable via prompt-cache / KV prefix share. Fusible: a batched-prefill path is allowed and is not shipped (N016). INTERACTIVE uses the warm short-prompt figure.

cold_prefill_wall_ns.note: cold prefill_wall_ns over 3 process-or-rep samples. MTLCommandBuffer GPUEnd−GPUStart lives in gpu_ns_per_step; this wall includes host encode/submit/wait.

warm_prefill_wall_ns.note: warm prefill_wall_ns over 7 process-or-rep samples. MTLCommandBuffer GPUEnd−GPUStart lives in gpu_ns_per_step; this wall includes host encode/submit/wait.

prefill.note: q4 short prompt_len=34 warm_prefill_wall median 1029733542.0 ns. cold_prefill_wall median 1197492042.0 ns. GPU_LEDGER_RAW cold_generate.prefill_wall_ns corroborates [1141.764, 1149.495, 1145.698] ms.

sampler.classification_reason: Production greedy is sample_argmax_f32 inside the decode CB; already fused (one CB, 964 dispatches includes the argmax). Not cacheable. Host readback is 4 bytes. CPU softmax/top-p is not on the INTERACTIVE greedy path.

host_sample_readback_ns.note: Host read of the sampled u32 after the CB wait. Sampling compute is the argmax dispatch inside the CB.

sampler.note: Isolated family 'argmax' GPU ns reps [433666.0, 335499.0, 332124.0]. Host sample_readback median 792 ns (MEASURED, MEASURED). GPU_LEDGER live_ns (scaled onto this session) 287395.3146927697 ns is DERIVED and is not the headline. scheduling.classification_reason: Scheduler.dispatch always persists the DAG. Avoidable: persist on dirty flag. Cacheable: in-process unit set. Not GPU-fusible.
scheduling.note: Reused N022 scheduler_cycle (not re-timed). cold_median_ms=0.71 warm_median_ms=0.555. INTERACTIVE overlay uses the warm figure (process already up).

token_latency_p50.classification_reason: p50 of the INTERACTIVE complete-token wall distribution (n=180). Same physical work as TPOT.
token_latency_p50.note: p50 of pooled_steady_complete_wall_ns converted to ms.

token_latency_p95.classification_reason: p95 of the INTERACTIVE complete-token wall distribution (n=180). Same physical work as TPOT.
token_latency_p95.note: p95 of pooled_steady_complete_wall_ns converted to ms.

token_latency_p99.classification_reason: p99 of the INTERACTIVE complete-token wall distribution (n=180). Same physical work as TPOT.
token_latency_p99.note: p99 of pooled_steady_complete_wall_ns converted to ms.

tpot.classification_reason: Steady complete-token wall. Not avoidable: each token streams ~13.6 GiB of active weights. Not cacheable per token. Fusible: dispatch fusion / organ cuts on the 964-dispatch graph (N025).

extra.complete_token_definition: encode + submit + wait + epilogue + sample_readback + state_update + tokenizer_decode + bookkeeping + residual

tpot.note: Complete-token wall from GPU_LEDGER_RAW pooled_steady_complete_wall_ns (n=180 steps across 3 process runs). Definition: one native decode step + host encode/submit/wait/sample_readback/state/tokenizer/bookkeeping. Prefill excluded. This IS TPOT and the inter-token gap on the INTERACTIVE stream.

ttft.classification_reason: User-visible time to first token of a Hawking WorkUnit at c=1 on the q4 incumbent. Dominated by prefill of the chat prompt. Cacheable: prompt-cache. Fusible: batched prefill not shipped. Not avoidable for a new user turn.
ttft.note: INTERACTIVE product TTFT = PRODUCTION_BENCH q4_incumbent c=1 concurrent_independent ttft_s (WorkUnit prompts, prompt_token_counts=[47, 49, 50, 56, 47, 51, 53, 62, 61, 109, 60, 78, 51]). Decode-path definition (GPU_LEDGER): last prefill step emits new-token[0]; steady TPOT is new-tokens[1..] only. Short compiler-prompt prefill is the PREFILL stage, not this row — WorkUnit prompts are longer (~47–109 tokens) so TTFT > short prefill.

warm_start.classification_reason: Warm INTERACTIVE start is a new short prompt on an already-resident q4 process (pipelines compiled, page cache hot). Prefill still runs unless the prefix hits the prompt cache. Same samples as the prefill stage.
warm_start.note: Warm-start == warm short prefill on this runtime. Not TPOT.

totals.definition: interactive_first_token_ms = warm context_compile + scheduling + admission + prefill (model resident, app warm). Sampler is inside the prefill/decode CB and is not added again. interactive_token_ms = median complete-token wall (TPOT). interactive_cold_ms = graph-cold first step + weight load. user_visible_ttft_ms = PRODUCTION_BENCH c=1 WorkUnit TTFT (longer prompts; not mixed into the short-prompt composition).

production_winner_not_interactive.note: c=4 wins verified WUs/hour and is not the INTERACTIVE profile. INTERACTIVE is c=1. Both cells are MEASURED; this ledger reports c=1.
